target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure covers the assumption of VMware equity awards for continuing employees and the acceleration/conversion of non-employee director awards. The 2024 filings split this topic: D071 covers the assumption/conversion of employee RSU/PSU awards (and director acceleration), while D126 specifically details the assumption of awards under the 2007 Plan and the conversion into 46 million Broadcom RSUs for continuing employees. These two 2024 disclosures collectively cover the subject matter of the single 2023 disclosure regarding equity award assumption.

comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Equity Incentive Plan Approval and Share Reservations
comparisons.peer_summary: On May 18, 2023, the Company approved the AMD 2023 Equity Incentive Plan, which supersedes the Prior Plans, with 87,645,874 shares reserved for future awards. As of December 28, 2024, 60 million shares were available for future grants, and 34 million shares were reserved for issuance upon exercise or vesting.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose their equity compensation plans and the specific vesting schedules for Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) under those plans. AVGO specifically details the assumption of VMware awards which convert to Broadcom RSUs vesting generally over four years. Similarly, AMD discloses that its 2023 Equity Incentive Plan reserves shares for awards, with generally stock options and RSUs vesting over a four-year period. While AMD focuses on the new plan's reservation and general terms, and AVGO focuses on the merger-specific conversion mechanics, both confirm a four-year vesting norm for equity awards.

sentences.text: These assumed awards were converted into approximately 46 million Broadcom RSU awards and will vest in accordance with their original terms, generally over four years.
Generally, stock options granted under the 2023 Plan vest and become exercisable over a four-year period from the date of grant and expire within seven years after the grant date.

comparisons.peer_topic: RSU and PSU Grant Terms and Vesting
comparisons.peer_summary: The 2006 Plan authorizes RSUs and stock options, with PSUs granted to senior officers and employees vesting after three years and one month. Other RSU and option awards generally vest over four years, with 10 million PSUs outstanding as of December 28, 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and Intel disclose the vesting terms for their respective equity awards, specifically noting that standard RSUs generally vest over four years. AVGO states that assumed Broadcom RSU awards 'will vest in accordance with their original terms, generally over four years.' Intel states that 'Other RSU awards and option awards generally vest over four years from the grant date.' Both companies utilize a four-year vesting horizon as a standard benchmark for their long-term incentive equity.

sentences.text: These assumed awards were converted into approximately 46 million Broadcom RSU awards and will vest in accordance with their original terms, generally over four years.
Other RSU awards and option awards generally vest over four years from the grant date.

comparisons.peer_topic: Restricted Stock Awards Vesting Terms and Dividend Equivalents
comparisons.peer_summary: As of August 29, 2024, 28 million Restricted Stock Awards were outstanding, with service-based awards vesting in annual or quarterly increments depending on the grant date, while performance-based awards vest over three years with payouts ranging from 0% to 200% of targets, and dividend equivalent rights apply to certain unvested units.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and Micron disclose the vesting mechanics for their Restricted Stock Awards/Units. AVGO notes that assumed RSUs vest 'generally over four years.' Micron discloses that service-based Restricted Stock Awards generally vest on 25% after the first year and then quarterly over the remaining years (implying a multi-year, typically 4-year, vesting schedule for standard awards), while performance-based awards vest over a 3-year period. Both companies use time-based vesting periods exceeding one year for their standard RSU grants.

sentences.text: These assumed awards were converted into approximately 46 million Broadcom RSU awards and will vest in accordance with their original terms, generally over four years.

Service-based Restricted Stock Awards granted after October 2021 generally vest on 25% or 33% of the units granted after the first year and on 6.25% or 8.33% each quarter thereafter over the remaining three or two years of employment.

comparisons.peer_topic: Equity Incentive Plans and Awards Granted
comparisons.peer_summary: The company grants or has granted stock options, RSUs, PSUs, market-based PSUs, and stock purchase rights under its equity incentive plans. Additionally, stock-based awards assumed in acquisitions are converted into the company's RSUs.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVIDIA disclose the treatment of equity awards assumed in connection with acquisitions. AVGO states it 'assumed the VMware... Plan and outstanding unvested RSU awards... converting them into approximately 46 million Broadcom RSU awards.' NVIDIA states that 'in connection with our acquisitions of various companies, we have assumed certain stock-based awards... and converted them into our RSUs.' Both companies explicitly describe a process of assuming pre-acquisition equity awards and converting them into their own company's RSU awards to maintain continuity for acquired talent.

sentences.text: In connection with the VMware Merger, we assumed the VMware, Inc. Amended and Restated 2007 Equity and Incentive Plan (the "2007 Plan") and outstanding unvested RSU awards and PSU awards originally granted by VMware under the 2007 Plan that were held by continuing employees.
In addition, in connection with our acquisitions of various companies, we have assumed certain stock-based awards granted under their stock incentive plans and converted them into our RSUs.
